title: wg: protocol-06 §5.1/§5.7 consent placeholders user vs domain
description: Erratum. §5.1 directory (L1035-1037) has requestConsent/{targetUser} and updateConsent/{requesterUser}; §5.7 (L2219-2220) defines /requestConsent/{targetDomain} and /updateConsent/{requesterDomain}. A peer copying §5.1 publishes templates others can't expand. mimid follows §5.7 and decodes leniently (decisions mimid-1wgh.5.16, .5.42). Fix: use the domain names in §5.1. Related to mimid-1wgh.5.39 but separate.
